candidate_windows.window_text: We used the Huggingface Transformers library in order to run LLaMA models. We used beam search with beam size $= 2$ during generation and max new tokens $= 5$ while using the default values for all the other parameters in the generate method. We run our model on a 40-GB VRAM A-100 GPU card.
